recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce Condition.occurredFollowing children in core; any future change to the moved condition-occurredFollowing extension should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-5409 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Care ballot issue requesting Condition.occurredFollowing.codeableConcept be renamed to Condition.occurredFollowing.code because codeableConcept was a poor attribute name and likely a typographic error.
initial_application: Historical git-svn commit 32a14bb92d9bcbea7d25cbc1774a4e32576244ea, matching Jira's svn revision 4581 note, changed the Condition spreadsheets and DAF Condition profile spreadsheet from Condition.occurredFollowing.codeableConcept to Condition.occurredFollowing.code, including the old following-code search parameter expression.
additional_context: Later Published issues FHIR-7620 and FHIR-7621 moved Condition.dueTo and Condition.occurredFollowing from core Condition elements into extensions, and FHIR-10102 later changed those extensions from separate code/detail children to a CodeableConcept or Reference value[x] choice. The current core build still actively includes Condition, but the active Condition StructureDefinition no longer contains Condition.occurredFollowing. The current condition-occurredFollowing definition is in the FHIR Extension Pack and uses Extension.value[x] with CodeableConcept and Reference types.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The historical rename was applied, later WG decisions removed the old core child representation, and current source searches found no remaining obsolete Condition.occurredFollowing.codeableConcept path.
